scoring_justification: Derived features (peak, effective moment, elastic minima) are recomputed from the agent's raw CSV curves and compared to paper-reported values within tolerances.

outputs.description: Schottky specific heat of TmSb as a function of temperature. The checker will locate the Cm peak (temperature and magnitude) and compare to hidden references.
Inverse magnetic susceptibility of PrSb as a function of temperature. The checker will fit the high-temperature region and extract the effective magnetic moment, comparing to a hidden reference.

Temperature dependence of symmetry elastic constants for TmSb. The checker will locate the minima in c44 and c11-c12, verify their positions and depths against hidden references, and check the shoulder-like shape of c44.
Temperature-dependent strain-susceptibility functions f2(T) and f3(T) for TmSb (intermediate product).
Crystal-field energy levels of PrSb (intermediate product).
Crystal-field energy levels of TmSb (intermediate product).

output_contract.notes: All temperature values must be strictly ascending. The checker recomputes derived quantities from the raw curves; no self-reported metrics are scored. The elastic constant step is load-bearing: its output depends on the preceding diagonalization and strain-susceptibility steps, which must therefore be genuinely executed.
